leftEvidence.title: Jesus comes to John and speaks of fulfilling righteousness

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized; John resists, Jesus answers, and the baptism proceeds.
points.right: After all the people are baptized, Jesus is baptized and prays; heaven opens.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Opened heavens, descending Spirit, and a heavenly voice identify the beloved Son in whom God delights.
points.right: The Holy Spirit descends in bodily form like a dove, and the voice directly addresses the beloved Son.

payload.posture: Both preserve baptism, Spirit, dove comparison, beloved Son, and divine pleasure.
payload.tension: Luke adds the people and prayer while omitting the baptizer’s identity in the bounded scene.
payload.title: Matthew and Luke at the Jordan
